goal: VC-201-076 (P1) claims mastery of: Bind admitted extension manifests and managed adapter artifacts to checksums, signatures where available, and explicit trust policy; a changed artifact is quarantined until re-admitted.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: an ML-BOM target is catalogued with canonical capabilities and validated facts. Verified by `crates/susi-vendor-models/src/eco_ml_bom.rs`: profile_is_valid, capabilities_are_canonical, facts_cover_the_required_surface, store_stays_consistent. Residual: the mastery target's supply-chain binding - checksums and signatures on admitted extension manifests and managed adapter artifacts, explic. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_076_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence. Closing this task records the outcome, not a passing test: write .agents/roadmap-verdicts/<the vector>.json with verdict 'delivered' (and the test or record that proves it) or 'not-delivered' (with what is missing and the task ids that track the follow-up work), then run scripts/check-roadmap-verdict.py <the vector> — which is this task's acceptance. A refutation therefore closes the task and files the work, instead of stalling on a test that cannot pass; the roadmap and the queue both understand the record.
